taiwan_work_rights_2026: Verified 2026-09-21: since 2026-01-01 an international graduate of a Taiwanese university may stay and work in Taiwan for two years after graduating WITHOUT a work permit, not tied to an employer (amended Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals). This removes the visa gate from every Taiwan-based job route from 2027-01, and makes the job path reversible in a way the PhD deadlines are not. The authority file still records this as unverified; it is now in force.
